prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1218; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the left. Both drivers are reported to be uninjured at scene except for the claimant, who reports neck and back pain. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant states they are not represented by an attorney and wish to handle the claim directly. Claimant describes stiffness in the neck and lower back beginning the day after the accident, with pain worse in the morning. Claimant has seen a primary care provider and is following a course of physical therapy. Medical authorization forms sent for signature.

Entry 3: Reviewed the scene photographs and damage estimates. Damage to the rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle and the front passenger side of the other vehicle is consistent with a sideswipe at low to moderate speed. No airbag deployment reported. Liability appears to lean toward the other driver, pending statements from both parties and the police report.

Entry 4: Received signed medical authorization from claimant. Requested records from primary care provider and physical therapy clinic. Claimant confirmed by email that they have no current attorney and prefer to communicate directly. Explained the claims process and the right to seek legal advice if they choose. Follow-up call scheduled.

Entry 5: Claimant reports pain has improved but still limits lifting and prolonged sitting. Medical records received and under review; treatment consistent with strain injuries described. Liability assessment in progress, with recommendation to accept responsibility for the other driver's share pending final statements. Diary set for review once the physical therapy discharge summary is received.
